after_all.rejected_note: one proposal rejected while GPU 3 was being fenced

bugs_found_and_fixed: T-86 fencing compared process start times exactly; on Linux a start time read by another process differs by milliseconds, so power-off skipped the kill (old controller kept running and held the node lock; the restarted controller then failed). Tolerance 1 s on Linux only, exact on Windows.
T-86 fencing read MainModule of a renderer killed with its controller's process tree while it was exiting (null) -> NullReferenceException; now waits up to 2 s for exit, else fails closed.
limits: Not run on the Windows laptop with real Blender. Power-on waits up to 3 minutes for the restarted node (Blender probe/startup).
